# Streamline timeline icons

Sunō uses the two original PNG files supplied by the user for the timeline. Their filenames identify them as Streamline Plump Remix icons.

| App asset | Original filename |
| --- | --- |
| TimelineRunMountain | Mountain--Streamline-Plump-Remix.png |
| TimelineLiftCableCar | Cable-Car--Streamline-Plump-Remix.png |

Both files are unchanged 48 × 48 PNG images with transparency. The asset catalog treats them as 2× images and uses template rendering so the interface controls their color.
